Canadian aerospace firm FTG establishes first Indian manufacturing unit in Hyderabad

Canadian aerospace manufacturer FTG has opened its first manufacturing unit in India at the GMR Aerospace park in Hyderabad. The facility will produce advanced avionics. This marks a significant expansion for FTG into the Indian market.
